items.html: And then, when this fetus was born, since the aspect of the vessels needed for the aspect of the vessel of Nefesh was completed, then Mochin of Yenika were made in the middle NHY at the time of birth, as is known — for from the birth the time of the Yenika begins. Then vessels that are the aspect of Ruach are clarified, and they nurse in the secret of the milk, and within them is the spirituality of the Ruach, which is the Mochin of Yenika; and they are completed until Gadlut.
